name: estate-corridor-night-verify
description: ESTATE-CORRIDOR-NIGHT: the corridor night mask (`estateTextures.ts:paintFacadeTile`'s corridor branch, flag `estateCorridorNightMask`, default on) is a thin tube line + a wash confined to the upper ~60% of the void, replacing a full-height gradient that filled the whole corridor void and — at Estate.tsx's night emissive scale (up to x2.4) and the post stack's 1.35 bloom threshold — saturated/bloomed into one continuous white band the length of a wing, erasing the storey lines. This is the ON (default) arm. Boots into orbit at 20:00 for the boot framing, then walks to the service-yard pose (the neighbour block's corridor side is visible from here) and the living-room pose (control: window-side facade, must be unchanged by this fix). Run with SHOT_GPU=1. Pair with estate-corridor-night-verify-off.json (same scenario, flag forced off in setup before the estate's first paint) and img-diff each numbered screenshot pair.

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(20); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: pose-yard-night
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(5.42, 7.6); l.setYaw(Math.PI); l.setPitch(-0.1) })()

steps.name: pose-living-night
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 4.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()
